'''Mary Ellen''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who is mentioned in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].

==Character history==
Mary Ellen is, in [[1992]], the daughter of [[Mary-Beth Maybell]], the host of [[K-Rose]], who was, according to her mother, born on a pool table.
